**What should this component do?**
A short description of the UI pattern and the product need it solves.

**Which category does it belong in?**
e.g. Fintech, Dashboards, Interactive, Buttons, Loaders, Forms, Overlays, Marketing — or a new category.

**Reference (optional)**
Links, screenshots, or sketches of similar patterns you've seen elsewhere.

**Are you able to contribute the implementation yourself?**
Yes / No — either is fine, this just helps with planning.
